entities.name: Tuck
entities.description: Human warrior of Vryn who bullied young Jace Beleren.

entities.name: Caden
entities.description: Bully who joined Tuck; his mind was invaded by Jace.

entities.name: Jace Beleren
entities.description: Planeswalker, bullied as a child on Vryn; created the Echoverse.

entities.name: Repurposed Enforcers
entities.description: Beings Jace modeled on his childhood bully to control Hexhaven.

events.summary: At 14 Tuck, Caden and Jillet track down Jace and bully him until he falls off the mage-ring edge.
events.quote: bullied him until he fell off the edge

events.summary: Jace clings on, invades Caden's mind and uses him to climb up.
events.quote: invaded Caden's mind, taking him over

events.summary: Jace subconsciously uses his bully memory to create the Repurposed Enforcers in the Echoverse.
events.quote: using them to maintain control over Hexhaven

relations.quote: bullied him until he fell off the edge
